documentation.file_docstring:
Causal trace IDs for cross-agent distributed tracing.

Unlike simple correlation IDs, causal trace IDs encode the full
spawn/delegation tree, making distributed traces genuinely readable.

Format: {trace_id}/{span_id}[/{parent_span_id}]
member_docstrings: CausalTraceId: Encodes the full spawn/delegation tree for a trace.
child: Create a child span (e.g., when spawning a sub-agent or delegating).
sibling: Create a sibling span (same parent, different operation).
from_string: Parse a CausalTraceId from its string representation.
is_ancestor_of: Check if this trace is an ancestor of another (same trace tree).
